name: dev-workflow-mcp
description: dev-workflow 플러그인 Node 도구 — merge-to-domain MCP 서버(digest 추출, 검증, 체크포인트)와 search-ignore 생성 스크립트

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/search-ignore.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/search-ignore.js
scripts.pretest: esbuild test/digest.test.ts test/verify.test.ts test/checkpoint.test.ts test/search-ignore.p4ignore.test.ts test/search-ignore.scan.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outdir=test-dist
